subject.title: Dashboard: chart widgets (line, bar, area, sparkline, gauge)

question: Should OpenClaw accept first-party dashboard chart widgets as bundled dashboard-plugin builtins, or route charting to custom/ClawHub widgets until the dashboard surface is more settled?
rationale: The request fits web-frontend ergonomics but depends on unmerged dashboard infrastructure and a maintainer choice about bundled builtin scope versus external/custom widget distribution.

options.title: Review Linked PR After Prerequisites
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the linked PR after the dashboard base stack, binding contract, dependency guard, and proof blockers are resolved.

options.title: Route To Custom Or ClawHub Widgets
options.body: Ask contributors to prove charting through sandboxed/custom widgets or ClawHub packaging before adding more bundled builtins.

options.title: Defer Dashboard Builtins
options.body: Leave the feature in the roadmap but defer implementation until the broader modular dashboard direction is accepted or narrowed.

recommendation.title: Review Linked PR After Prerequisites
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the linked PR after the dashboard base stack, binding contract, dependency guard, and proof blockers are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current-main adjacent Control UI ownership signal among the likely owners and the decision is primarily bundled Control UI product direction.
